triage.reasoning: Annual service-charge statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) from the property manager with a balance to pay.

explainer.summary_en: Your property manager sent the service-charge statement for 2025. You paid 1,680.00 € in advance, but your share of the costs was 1,918.47 €, so you owe 238.47 €. From 01.01.2027 your monthly advance payment goes up from 140.00 € to 160.00 €.
key_points: Pay 238.47 € within 30 days of receiving the statement, to your usual rent account.
Your monthly advance payment rises to 160.00 € from January 2027.
You can inspect the receipts at their office by appointment.
Objections to the statement must be raised within twelve months of receiving it.
